question: How does the experience of time differ between other regions and Bharata?
premises: Action is observed to exist in other places as well, according to ancient tradition.
In those other regions the time is always like the Treta age.
In Bharata the full cycle of four ages occurs.
inference: Other regions may have action but remain fixed in a Treta-like condition, whereas Bharata passes through all four ages.
plain_english: Action is also found in other places, as the ancient tradition shows: there time remains always like Treta, but in Bharata the full cycle of four ages unfolds.
